BRIEF & AUDIENCE

A practice introduced through its work.

Create a website that introduces the practice through its work and makes consultation enquiries straightforward.

MY ROLE & SCOPE

Original brief, art direction, interface design, content structure, responsive development, and interaction design.

Architectural imagery consists of original concept illustrations. The buildings are visual studies, not commissioned work.

THREE DESIGN DECISIONS

The reasoning behind the interface.

01

Let the building lead

Large original concept illustrations and concise project titles put the practice’s work first.

03

Make consultation a separate decision

COURTYARD HOUSE / CONCEPT

Project-led navigation, project context, an approach statement, and a consultation brief.

↳ Specific content and navigation follow the visitor’s task.

Content structure & accessibility

Selected projects → project context and story → studio philosophy → consultation brief. Semantic navigation, visible keyboard focus, labelled controls, text alternatives for concept imagery, and announced interaction states keep the route understandable. Layouts stack naturally on mobile, with no motion required to access content.

Implemented and proposed

Implemented: project imagery, expandable project stories, studio approach, and a page-local consultation brief. Proposed: separate project pages and live consultation delivery; these are not implemented.

Concept note

These fictional projects do not represent completed buildings or commissioned work. The consultation form is a local demonstration and does not send enquiries. No commercial results or client endorsements are claimed.
